name: leaf_poisson_index_shift
twin: For every real v and integer m, v plus m equals the fractional part of v plus the integer m plus floor v.
instance: v equal to minus three halves and m equal to three give three halves on both sides.

name: leaf_poisson_index_ne_zero
twin: If m differs from minus floor v, then m plus floor v is nonzero.
instance: v equal to one half and m equal to one give shifted integer one.

name: leaf_poisson_index_ne_neg_one
twin: If m differs from minus the sum of floor v and one, then m plus floor v differs from minus one.
instance: v equal to one half and m equal to one give shifted integer one.

name: leaf_poisson_index_dichotomy
twin: Every integer other than zero and minus one is at least one or at most minus two.
instance: The integer one satisfies the first branch. Minus two satisfies the second branch.

name: leaf_poisson_index_upper
body:
have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  exact (by linarith [Int.fract_nonneg v] : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Int.fract v + (k : ℝ)).trans
    (le_abs_self _)
twin: For every real v and integer k at least one, the absolute value of fractional part v plus k is at least one.
instance: v equal to zero and k equal to one give equality.

name: leaf_poisson_index_lower
body:
have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≤ -2 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hneg : Int.fract v + (k : ℝ) < -1 := by linarith [Int.fract_lt_one v]
  exact (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ -(Int.fract v + (k : ℝ))).trans (neg_le_abs _)
twin: For every real v and integer k at most minus two, the absolute value of fractional part v plus k is at least one.
instance: v equal to one half and k equal to minus two give absolute value three halves.
